title: [AUG-13] Add upload progress bar with percentage
why_we_need_this: During file upload the UI shows only a spinner and static text. For large audio files (100+ MB meeting recordings), users have zero visibility into progress and may think the app is frozen.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `uploadAudio` in api.ts uses XMLHttpRequest (or equivalent) with `upload.onprogress` callback
- [ ] Dropzone area shows a determinate progress bar during upload
- [ ] Percentage and uploaded/total size are displayed (e.g., "45% — 52 MB / 115 MB")
- [ ] Progress bar uses existing design tokens (--accent color, --btn-radius)
- [ ] Spinner remains for the transcription-starting phase after upload completes
